hassio_confirm.description: Read Bible verses aloud with Assist, from the {app} app: say "John 3:16", then "next verse". Set it up?

user.title: EBaC (Electronic Bible and Concordance)
user.description: The address of ebac-api. The EBaC app's is filled in; with the app installed, Home Assistant normally finds it by itself.

translation.title: Translation, and what Assist may do
translation.description: The translation EBaC reads from, to start with; the language to add translations in; and what Assist may do beyond reading. Anyone who can talk to a voice assistant can use what you allow here, with no user name or password: each box is off unless you check it, and each needs the one above it.

data.allow_change: Allow Assist to change the translation

data_description.translation: Only translations added in the EBaC app are listed: add others there, with A at its main menu.
data_description.source: "Add translation" said to Assist looks here, in the language below: thiagobodruk/bible or scrollmapper/bible_databases on GitHub, or Project Gutenberg (by ebook number: "add translation 8294"). Assist can change it: "use Gutenberg translations". A name said without its ending (-TB, -SM, -PG) means this source's: "NIV" is NIV-TB.
data_description.language: "Add translation" said to Assist looks in this language. Assist can change it: "use Spanish translations". The list comes from the EBaC app when its options allow adding.
data_description.allow_change: Risk: anyone who can talk to a voice assistant, with no password, could switch to a translation you keep private (your own diary, imported as one) and hear it read aloud. Off: Assist reads only the translation above.
data_description.allow_add: Needs changing allowed. The EBaC app's "Allow voice to add translations" option must be on too.
data_description.allow_remove: Needs adding allowed. Risk: someone could delete a translation you paid for, such as the NIV (Assist asks "Are you sure?" first). The EBaC app's "Allow voice to remove translations" option must be on too.

error.cannot_connect: EBaC didn't answer at that address. Is the EBaC app started?
error.no_translations: EBaC answered, but has no translations.
error.add_needs_change: Adding translations needs changing the translation allowed too: check the box above it.
error.remove_needs_add: Removing translations needs adding allowed too: check the box above it.

confirm.title: The EBaC app can't be reached
confirm.description:
EBaC hasn't answered at {url} for over 15 minutes. The EBaC app may have been stopped, or removed.

- **If it was stopped**, start it again (Settings > Apps > EBaC).
- **If it was removed** and you want EBaC back, install the app again. Removing it deleted its translations and search history; restoring a backup made before then (Settings > System > Backups) brings them back.
- **If you're done with EBaC**, remove this integration too (Settings > Devices & services > EBaC > Delete).

This clears itself when EBaC answers again. Press **Submit** to clear it now; it won't be shown again until EBaC has answered and then stopped again.
